# Cold Stack tool reference

In an authorized umbrella checkout, run `./cold list` to see availability and install
support. Run `./cold install TOOL` to preview or add `--apply` to install.
Run `cold doctor --json` for schema version 1 launcher and PATH checks. Exit 0 means
healthy, 1 means a problem and 2 means an error.

The tool entries below describe public interfaces where available.

## Coldbox

Run CI jobs in disposable VMs on your own hardware. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldbox --apply`. Run `coldbox --help` for commands.
See [Coldbox documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldbox) for setup and usage.
coldbox status --json. The API uses exit codes 75 and 125 for retry and infrastructure failure.
coldbox api version

## Coldcleaner

Preview disk cleanup and verify archives before deleting files. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldcleaner --apply`. Run `coldcleaner --help` for commands.
See [Coldcleaner documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldcleaner) for setup and usage.
coldcleaner doctor --json reports prerequisites. Exit 0 means success, 1 a finding or refusal, and 2 an error.

## Coldlocker

Share skills, rules, hooks and MCP across agents. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldlocker --apply`. Run `coldlocker --help` for commands.
See [Coldlocker documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldlocker) for setup and usage.
coldlocker scan --json emits the inventory.
Connect a client to the stdio MCP endpoint, then use hub_list_skills and hub_get_item.

## Coldfix

Scan for recurring agent mistakes and rerun proofs from the lesson library. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldfix --apply`. Run `coldfix --help` for commands.
See [Coldfix documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldfix) for setup and usage.
coldfix check --json REPO exits 0 for clean, 1 for findings and 2 for incomplete or error.
See the repository for ColdRecall hook setup.

## Coldvault

Search a local vault of agent conversations and repository notes. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldvault --apply`. Run `coldvault --help` for commands.
See [Coldvault documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldvault) for setup and usage.
python3 coldvault.py search QUERY --json --vault VAULT returns an object with schema_version 1 and a hits array. Exit 0 means matches, 1 means no matches, and 2 returns a JSON object with an error field.

## Coldpass

Browse public README trial results and run evidence. Availability: web only. Cold install: no.
See [Coldpass documentation](https://coldpass.dev) for setup and usage.
Read the public API at https://coldpass.dev/api/v1/index.json.
The downloadable client provides stdio MCP. See https://coldpass.dev/llms.txt.

## Coldrelease

Scan and verify an export before making it public. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldrelease --apply`. Run `coldrelease --help` for commands.
See [Coldrelease documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldrelease) for setup and usage.
coldrelease --version --json and coldrelease audit . --json report schema version 1.

## Coldverify

Replay an observed failure and its fix across two revisions. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldverify --apply`. Run `coldverify --help` for commands.
See [Coldverify documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldverify) for setup and usage.
coldverify --version --json returns schema_version, exit_code and version data.

## Coldguardian

Check approved home networks for changes and risky services. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldguardian --apply`. Run `coldguardian --help` for commands.
See [Coldguardian documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldguardian) for setup and usage.
coldguardian status --json validates local configuration without starting a scan.

## ColdRewind

Checkpoint a workspace and restore local files and Git state. Availability: public source. Cold install: yes.
Install with `cold install coldrewind --apply`. Run `coldrewind --help` for commands.
See [ColdRewind documentation](https://github.com/coldstack-dev/coldrewind) for setup and usage.
coldrewind status --json reports the workspace snapshot backend and last capture error.
coldrewind init --client claude installs hooks for Claude Code. The codex and opencode clients are also supported.

## Coldcontribute

Find contribution opportunities requested by maintainers. Availability: parked. Cold install: no.
